mechanisms.mechanism: PolyFeaturesImplementation forwards absent optional degree or interaction_only parameters as None, overriding sklearn PolynomialFeatures defaults and making a valid partially specified public operation fail.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Forward only explicitly supplied polynomial parameters so omitted values retain estimator defaults.

mechanisms.mechanism: LDA accepts shrinkage while retaining the incompatible default svd solver, so a valid public parameter combination reaches sklearn and raises NotImplementedError.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Select a shrinkage-compatible effective solver when shrinkage is supplied and no compatible solver was explicitly chosen.

mechanisms.mechanism: Oversized lagged windows are corrected with a random draw, so identical fits on identical time-series data choose different effective windows and fitted behavior.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Use one deterministic, legal correction derived from the input series and forecast horizon.

mechanisms.mechanism: Polyfit writes a fit-time corrected degree back into public OperationParameters, changing PipelineNode.descriptive_id and cache identity during fit.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Keep the corrected degree in fitted implementation state without mutating public node parameters.

mechanisms.mechanism: Fit-time preprocessing normalizes non-finite features but lets positive or negative infinity in a numeric target reach downstream estimators instead of handling it consistently with missing targets.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Normalize non-finite numeric target values before the ordinary missing-target policy is applied.

mechanisms.mechanism: DataMerger filters each parent by index membership while preserving each parent's local row order, then concatenates by position and mixes sample identities when unique parent indices have different orders.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Align unique parent rows to the main output's canonical index order before concatenation while preserving ambiguous duplicate-index behavior.

mechanisms.mechanism: The lagged transformation mistakes one time-series column for one-dimensional input, leaves a valid shape (n, 1) array two-dimensional, and constructs an invalid three-dimensional lag tensor.
mechanisms.proposed_change: Choose flattening from input dimensionality and ravel every column of a two-dimensional input, including a single-column input.
